snippet: In my life there have been no closer allies in musical support and brotherhood than my beloved 'Neil Cowley Trio' cohorts Rex Horan and Evan Jenkins. So in my quest to end a period of musical solitude it was obvious to me who I should call; and so a studio reunion was arranged.

Neil Cowley is a contemporary pianist and composer who has released music as part of Fragile State, the Green Nuns of the Revolution, and the Neil Cowley Trio. The trio won the 2007 BBC Jazz Award for best album and performed on Later... with Jools Holland, but went on hiatus in 2018.
